title: What Google imagines comes next for you
title_candidates: Why the new Google laptop doesn't work like any laptop you've used
The Google laptop built to sync across every screen you already own
Google just made a laptop with 14 hours of battery and one thing no one expected
What Google put in a laptop that makes every other brand look a step behind
The first laptop Google designed to start right where your phone leaves off
caption:
Google's Googlebook is a new category of laptop built around one idea: the moment you open it, it already knows where you left off on your phone. A 2.8K OLED touchscreen and 14-hour battery are the hardware story. The bigger one is that it is engineered to sync across every Google product you already use, with no setup and no cables.

Most laptops and phones live in separate worlds. You move between them by copying, re-logging in, and starting over. The Googlebook is Google's answer to that problem. All the performance, none of the switching cost.

It is available for preorder now.
